# prettier-plugin-matryoshka

## Short Summary
Recursive, dynamic Prettier plugin that formats nested multi-language code blocks via `:::parserName` tags.

## Installation
`npm i -D prettier prettier-plugin-matryoshka` | `yarn add -D prettier prettier-plugin-matryoshka` | `pnpm add -D prettier prettier-plugin-matryoshka`

## Usage Patterns

### Vue + Twig
```txt
:::vue
<template><div>{{ count }}</div></template>
:::twig
<div>{{ "hello"|capitalize }}</div>
:::endtwig
<script setup>const count = ref(0)</script>
:::endvue
```

### HTML + CSS
```txt
:::html
<div class="card">Hello</div>
:::css
.card { color: red; }
:::endcss
:::endhtml
```

### Markdown + JavaScript
```txt
:::markdown
# Demo
:::babel
const sum = (a,b)=>a+b
:::endbabel
:::endmarkdown
```

## Configuration Schema
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "parser": { "const": "matryoshka" },
    "plugins": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "matryoshkaParserOverrides": {
      "description": "Per-parser Prettier overrides.",
      "oneOf": [
        { "type": "string", "description": "JSON string object" },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "matryoshkaLogLevel": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["silent", "error", "warn", "info", "debug"],
      "default": "silent"
    },
    "matryoshkaLogPrefix": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "[matryoshka]"
    }
  },
  "required": ["parser"]
}
```
